title: lm-assist MCP plugin manifest (mcp-plugin.json)
description: Manifest for a third-party MCP tool plugin loaded by lm-assist. The manifest is parsed WITHOUT executing anything: it is the discovery + human-review surface. See docs/mcp-plugin-contract.md for the full contract.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor completion.

manifestVersion.description: Contract version. Only 1 exists; lm-assist rejects unknown versions rather than guessing.

name.description: Plugin id. MUST equal the plugin directory name. No consecutive separators (so the ext__<plugin>__<tool> namespace stays unambiguous).

version.description: Semantic version of the plugin payload.

description.description: One-line summary shown on the /mcp-tools review screen.

entry.description: How to spawn the MCP stdio server. Structured on purpose: never a shell string, spawned with shell:false.

command.description: Interpreter allow-list. v1 permits only Node (the runtime lm-assist already ships).

items.description: A plugin-relative path or a --flag. No absolute paths, no '..', no shell metacharacters.

tools.description: The tools this plugin advertises. AUTHORITATIVE: lm-assist advertises exactly these, without spawning the plugin. A tool that appears only at runtime is never exposed.

capabilities.description: Everything the plugin needs. Undeclared access is denied; declarations are also the human-review surface.

keepWarm.description: Request that the subprocess stay resident between calls instead of being stopped when idle. Honoured at lm-assist's discretion.

timeoutMs.description: Advisory per-call timeout request. lm-assist clamps to its own hard cap.

checksum.description: Payload digest over every file in the plugin directory EXCEPT mcp-plugin.json. See the contract for the exact canonical algorithm. Pinned at enable time; a change auto-reverts the plugin to disabled.

name.description: LOCAL tool name, unprefixed. lm-assist exposes it as ext__<plugin>__<name>; the plugin still receives this local name in tools/call.

description.description: What the tool does — this is what the calling model reads.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the tool arguments. MUST be an object schema (MCP requirement).

annotations.description: Optional MCP behaviour hints. Advisory only — never a security control.

items.description: host or *.suffix, optional :port. No scheme, no path. Loopback/private/link-local targets are rejected by the validator.
<pluginDir>, <scratchDir>, or an absolute path; optional :ro (default) or :rw suffix.

Names of environment variables the plugin needs. Values come from the owner-supplied grant store — NEVER inherited from the lm-assist process. Reserved names (LM_*, PATH, HOME, NODE_OPTIONS, LD_PRELOAD, ...) cannot be declared.
